title: FinRED: An Expert-Guided Benchmark Generation and Evaluation Framework for Financial LLM Red-Teaming
abstract: arXiv:2606.19887v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Existing safety benchmarks target general adversarial scenarios but miss finance-specific risks. Financial LLMs face regulatory compliance violations, fraud facilitation, and systemic trust erosion that require targeted evaluation. We introduce FinRED, an expert-guided red-teaming framework for financial LLM safety evaluation developed with financial experts. FinRED uses a novel two-level taxonomy mapping global standards (e.g., FATF and EU DORA) to threats ranging from regulatory evasion to complex fraud, integrated with a scalable pipeline that converts real financial documents into context-rich red-teaming Behavioral Prompts (seeds) through an expert-defined schema. Rigorous expert validation confirms seed plausibility and realism for meaningful LLM safety evaluation. We also provide an expert-validated, finance-specific rubric that goes beyond disclaimer checks, aligns more closely with human experts than static one-size-fi

translated_title: FinRED：一个专家指导的金融大语言模型红队测试基准生成与评估框架
translated_abstract: 现有的安全基准主要针对一般对抗性场景，但忽略了金融领域的特定风险。金融大语言模型面临监管合规违规、协助欺诈和系统性信任侵蚀等问题，需要有针对性的评估。我们提出了FinRED，这是一个由金融专家参与开发的、专家指导的金融大语言模型安全评估红队测试框架。FinRED采用了一种新颖的两级分类法，将全球标准（如FATF和EU DORA）映射到从监管规避到复杂欺诈的各类威胁，并结合了一个可扩展的流水线，通过专家定义的模式将真实金融文档转换为具有丰富上下文的红队测试行为提示（种子）。严格的专家验证确认了种子的合理性和真实性，可用于有意义的大语言模型安全评估。我们还提供了经过专家验证的金融领域专用评分标准，超越了免责声明检查，比静态的一刀切方法更贴近人类专家的判断。
tldr: FinRED是一个由金融专家指导的红队测试框架，通过将全球金融监管标准映射为威胁分类体系，并利用可扩展流水线将真实金融文档转化为行为提示种子，同时提供专家验证的金融专用评分标准，为金融大语言模型的安全性评估建立了更贴近人类专家判断的基准。
en_tdlr: FinRED is an expert-guided red-teaming framework that maps global financial regulatory standards into a two-level threat taxonomy and converts real financial documents into context-rich behavioral prompt seeds, providing expert-validated benchmarks and a finance-specific rubric that better aligns with human experts for financial LLM safety evaluation.
